title: File:Burmese tattooing.jpg
author: Philip Adolphe Klier
description: Burmese tattooingEvery Burman who has any self-respect is tattooed in blue from the waist, about the top of the cloth to the knee. The figures of tigers, ogres and so forth are encircled with scroll lettering. The tattooing on the body and arms is in red, and is intended to secure immunity from sword or gun-shot wounds, or success in love.
